convertToStudent.description: Tick and save to auto-create a Student record from this lead (name, email, WhatsApp, intake carried over) and mark it handled. One-way — unchecking does not delete the student. Legacy advisor-driven path; the verified-lead flow below provisions a Student automatically on code verification instead.

dedupeKey.description: Normalized contact (lowercased/trimmed email) used to detect a reused contact and restore the existing verified account instead of re-granting wallet credits.
